The law: Article 144 of Criminal Law: “生产、销售有毒有害食品罪” includes adding harmful substances to food. Even if unintentional? It says knowingly. But if he didn't know, maybe not. If used incorrectly, could be “非法添加食品添加剂罪”. However typical Chinese criminal classification: “生产、销售有毒有害食品罪” covers adding harmful substances. The defendant didn't intend to cause harm, but still illegal. Also “过失致人死亡罪”. So list both.
